scope: Functional MathBoard workshop; isolated origin, no production scene rollout
databaseMigrations: Not needed: no database or save middleware in preview

checks.mixedBatch: [true, false, true], total 9, one completion callback

browserMethod: Playwright standalone Chromium. Shared Playwright MCP was busy, so it was left untouched.
visualFindings: Frame caps preserve their aspect ratio; only the straight frame center changes width.
Number ink is centered independently of its font line box.
Choice frame, glyph and status badge share a moving surface; root targets stay fixed.
Answer state is conveyed by a check or cross, in addition to color.
Long expressions retain every operand and operator; no overlap with choices.
Comparison target is empty before an answer; all three choices remain neutral.
Final tablet layouts were rechecked after fixing the specimen rail's minimum width.
No-word screenshots retain the visual task, choices, power and progress; audio is optional.
limitations: Production scenes, rewards, preparation persistence and save integration are not changed by the workshop.
The new personal speed bonus is outside this preview; it uses current production speed charges.
Touchscreen checks use Playwright touch events, not a physical Samsung GPU.
A real child playtest is still required before release approval.
Repository-wide TypeScript checking reports existing errors in AssetFactory, SaveSystem and telemetry; the isolated workshop build passes.
